mnd12:87.2: samaṇesu na koci bālo hīno nihīno omako lāmako jatukko paritto atthi; sabb' eva aggapaññā seṭṭhapaññā viseṭṭhapaññā pāmokkhapaññā uttamapaññā pavarapaññā ti,
mnd12:91.1: Aññaṃ ito yābhivadanti dhammaṃ aparaddhā suddhim akevalī te ti
mnd12:91.2: ito aññaṃ dhammaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ ye abhivadanti, te suddhimaggaṃ visuddhimaggaṃ parisuddhimaggaṃ vodātamaggaṃ pariyodātamaggaṃ viraddhā aparaddhā khalitā gaḷitā aññāya aparaddhā akevalī te, asamattā te, aparipuṇṇā te, hīnā nihīnā omakā lāmakā jatukkā parittā ti,
mnd12:91.3: aññaṃ ito yābhivadanti dhammaṃ aparaddhā suddhim akevalī te.
mnd12:92.1: Evam pi titthyā puthuso vadantī ti.
mnd12:92.4: puthudiṭṭhiyā puthudiṭṭhigatāni vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantī ti,
mnd12:93.2: sakāya diṭṭhiyā diṭṭhirāgena rattā abhirattā ti,
mnd12:97.1: Idh' evā suddhiṃ iti vādiyantī ti
mnd12:97.2: idha suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti:
mnd12:97.3: sassato loko, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti idha suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharanti:
mnd12:97.5: n' eva hoti na na hoti tathāgato param maraṇā, idam eva saccaṃ, mogham aññan ti idha suddhiṃ visuddhiṃ parisuddhiṃ muttiṃ vimuttiṃ parimuttiṃ vadanti kathenti bhaṇanti dīpayanti voharantī ti,
mnd12:98.2: attano satthāraṃ dhammakkhānaṃ gaṇaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭipadaṃ maggaṃ ṭhapetvā sabbe paravāde khipanti ukkhipanti parikkhipanti:
mnd12:98.3: so satthā na sabbaññū, dhammo na svākkhāto, gaṇo na supaṭipanno, diṭṭhi na bhaddikā, paṭipadā na supaññattā, maggo na niyyāniko; n' atth' ettha suddhi vā visuddhi vā parisuddhi vā mutti vā vimutti vā parimutti vā, n' atth' ettha sujjhanti vā visujjhanti vā parisujjhanti vā muccanti vā vimuccanti vā parimuccanti vā, hīnā nihīnā omakā lāmakā jatukkā parittā ti, evam āhaṃsu, evaṃ kathenti, evaṃ bhaṇanti, evaṃ dīpayanti, evaṃ voharantī ti,
mnd12:99.1: Evam pi titthyā puthuso niviṭṭhā ti.
mnd12:99.4: puthudiṭṭhiyā puthudiṭṭhigatesu niviṭṭhā patiṭṭhitā allīnā upagatā ajjhositā adhimuttā ti,
mnd12:100.2: Dhammo sakāyanaṃ, diṭṭhi sakāyanaṃ, paṭipadā sakāyanaṃ, maggo sakāyanaṃ; sakāyane daḷhavādā thiravādā balikavādā avatthitavādā ti,
mnd12:103.2: kam ettha bālo ti paraṃ daheyya?
mnd12:104.1: Sakāyane vā pi daḷhaṃ vadāno ti.
mnd12:104.2: Dhammo sakāyanaṃ, diṭṭhi sakāyanaṃ, paṭipadā sakāyanaṃ, maggo sakāyanaṃ; sakāyane daḷhavādo thiravādo balikavādo avatthitavādo ti,
mnd12:105.1: Kam ettha bālo ti paraṃ daheyyā? ti.
mnd12:105.2: Etthā ti sakāya diṭṭhiyā, sakāya khantiyā, sakāya ruciyā, sakāya laddhiyā, paraṃ bālato hīnato nihīnato omakato lāmakato jatukkato parittato kaṃ daheyya, kaṃ passeyya, kaṃ dakkheyya, kam olokeyya, kaṃ nijjhayeyya, kaṃ upaparikkheyyā ti,
mnd12:105.3: kam ettha bālo ti paraṃ daheyya?
mnd12:106.1: Sayam eva so medhagaṃ āvaheyya paraṃ vadaṃ bālam asuddhidhamman ti
mnd12:106.2: paro bālo hīno nihīno omako lāmako jatukko paritto asuddhidhammo avisuddhidhammo aparisuddhidhammo avodātadhammo ti
mnd12:106.3: evaṃ vadanto, evaṃ kathento, evaṃ bhaṇanto, evaṃ dīpayanto, evaṃ voharanto, sayam eva kalahaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ viggahaṃ vivādaṃ medhagaṃ āvaheyya samāvaheyya āhareyya samāhareyya ākaḍḍheyya samākaḍḍheyya gaṇheyya parāmaseyya abhiniviseyyā ti, sayam
mnd12:106.4: eva so medhagaṃ āvaheyya paraṃ vadaṃ bālaṃ asuddhidhammaṃ.
mnd12:108.2: kam ettha bālo ti paraṃ daheyya?
mnd12:109.4: na medhagaṃ kurute jantu loke ti. || :17 ||
mnd12:110.3: Vinicchaye vinicchitadiṭṭhiyā ṭhatvā patiṭṭhahitvā gaṇhitvā parāmasitvā abhinivisitvā ti, vinicchaye ṭhatvā.
mnd12:110.4: Sayaṃ pamāyā ti sayaṃ pamāya paminitvā,
mnd12:110.5: ayaṃ satthā sabbaññū ti sayaṃ pamāya paminitvā;
mnd12:110.10: ayaṃ maggo niyyāniko ti sayaṃ pamāya paminitvā ti,
mnd12:111.1: Uddhaṃ so lokasmiṃ vivādam etī ti.
mnd12:111.3: attano vādaṃ uddhaṃ ṭhapetvā sayam eva kalahaṃ bhaṇḍanaṃ viggahaṃ vivādaṃ medhagaṃ eti upeti upagacchati gaṇhāti parāmasati abhinivisatī ti,
mnd12:111.4: evam pi uddhaṃ so lokasmiṃ vivādam eti.
mnd12:111.5: Athavā aññena uddhaṃ vādena saddhiṃ kalahaṃ karoti, bhaṇḍanaṃ karoti, viggahaṃ karoti, vivādaṃ karoti, medhagaṃ karoti:
mnd12:111.6: na tvaṃ imaṃ dhammavinayaṃ ājānāsi . . . pe . . .
mnd12:111.8: evam pi uddhaṃ so lokasmiṃ vivādam eti.
mnd12:112.3: sabbā vinicchitadiṭṭhiyo hitvā cajjitvā pariccajitvā jahitvā pajahitvā vinoditvā byantīkaritvā anabhāvaṃ gametvā ti,
mnd12:113.1: Na medhagaṃ kurute jantu loke ti
mnd12:113.2: na kalahaṃ karoti, na bhaṇḍanaṃ karoti, na viggahaṃ karoti, na vivādaṃ karoti, na medhagaṃ karoti.
mnd12:113.4: *Evaṃ vimuttacitto kho Aggivessana bhikkhu na kenaci saṃvadati, na kenaci vivadati. Yañ ca loke vuttaṃ tena ca voharati aparāmasan ti.
mnd12:113.5: Jantū ti satto naro mānavo poso puggalo jīvo jagū jantu indagū manujo.
mnd12:113.6: Loke ti apāyaloke manussaloke devaloke khandhaloke dhātuloke āyatanaloke ti,
mnd12:113.7: na medhagaṃ kurute jantu loke ti.
